# AGT-MEM-01

**Can untrusted content be written to long-term memory, and if so, is it validated and attributed?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | MEM: Memory and context |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `elements.agent.memory` |

## Rule

Every agent with long_term_store states written_from_untrusted; when it is true, a guardrail or decision addresses memory poisoning.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026, ASI06 Memory and Context Poisoning (`owasp-asi06`)
- MITRE ATLAS AML.T0080, AI Agent Context Poisoning (`atlas-t0080`)
